cohort: 50 patients admitted with meconium stained amniotic fluid at Rohilkhand Medical College and Hospital, Bareilly, India between November 2022 and November 2023.
finding: Post-term pregnancy was the most common maternal risk factor associated with meconium stained amniotic fluid, and the most common perinatal complication was asphyxia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common mode of delivery in patients with meconium stained amniotic fluid.
